name: effect-light-sweep
title: Light Sweep
description: Một vệt sáng xiên, mờ mép quét qua bề mặt, sáng nhất khi đi qua giữa.

moworks.author: moworks

options.pad: px before and past the element (250)

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: On a gold pill (200×72, vertical gradient): an 80 px soft white band, skewed ~20°, sweeps from 50 px before to 50 px past the pill in 950 ms power2.inOut, additive; strength 0.9 × (0.3 + 0.7·exp(−(d / 60 px)²)), d = distance from the centre, so it is brightest mid-way (recipe: x −150 % → 250 %, blur 8, add). Params: duration (0.95 s) · width (80 px) · angle (≈20°) · strength đỉnh (0.9) · blend (add).
moworks.titleVi: Vệt sáng quét qua mặt bóng
